name: 深圳租金
description: Shenzhen rental ledger, project comparison and rent scenarios.
author: Anke Agent

agentTools.name: ShenzhenRents
agentTools.description: Query rental observations using imported/demo. Use dataset=history_sales for user-supplied 2023-2026 resale sales history (actual coverage ends 2024-04-25; 2025/2026 absent), or reference_202608 for community fields and source-declared WGS84 coordinates. Historical datasets accept only dataset,district,query,year,limit,offset; omit recordType/lease. Sale prices are not rents. 2026 reference fields cannot be backfilled as past training predictors. Return provenance and missing periods. Search through ToolSearch before use.

agentTools.name: ShenzhenRentKnowledge
agentTools.description: Query PostgreSQL-derived Shenzhen rental statistics and retrieve cited evidence. Use sync_status for per-platform refresh, successful observation time and verification blocks; periodic listing observations are not streaming transactions. Use this tool for ten-year coverage, yearly mean rent, district quarterly rents and community rents. Missing historical periods return no_observations. District names omit 区 except 大鹏新区. Search via ToolSearch before use.

agentTools.name: ResidentialEnvironment
agentTools.description: Default residential surrounding-environment measurement from GeoSegSAM-compatible georeferenced segmentation results. Requires image provenance, CRS, resolution, model and segments; missing imagery never receives an estimated score.

agentTools.name: ShenzhenRentEvents
agentTools.description: Read Shenzhen government notices and Tencent News media reports with distinct source provenance. Preserve evidence, dates, version, scope and source URLs. Rent effects have not been estimated.

agentTools.name: FindeskCapabilities
agentTools.description: Start with action=cookbook to select an official minimal scenario template; pass its exact scenario id as query to get complete code instead of guessing individual fields. action=plans returns public policy and quota pools; action=catalog searches capability contracts. Public information only, never infer current account balances or channel readiness. Authenticated entitlement uses GET /api/v1/entitlement.

agentTools.name: AnkeHousing
agentTools.description: Search government/university housing for a registered anonymous candidate. Returns independent resident survey ratings (0-5, response count, source/date) and personalized short/long-term matching scores (0-100). Call workspace then search_homes. Use provider=university for university supply, residentRating sort and explicit minRating/minReviewCount for review filters. Missing reviews stay null. Qualification and hard constraints precede ratings. Never invent scores, school eligibility or allocated supply.

agentTools.name: ZhuXiaoZhi
agentTools.description: Manage local housing work orders: create an order or advance material checks, review submission and housing shortlist. Operator gates protect recorded eligibility review, selection, signed contract and handover. Local records are not official online approvals.
